headline: CIN @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.42 at NYM 4.53, with a projected total of 8.95. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved +0.34 runs while NYM moved -1.20, changing the projected margin by +1.54 runs. The projected total fell -0.85, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +23.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chase Burns has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Steer, Carson Benge, Bo Bichette, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Luis Torrens because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
